name: Lithuanian road user charge (kelių naudotojo mokestis)
law: Kelių priežiūros ir plėtros programos finansavimo įstatymas; Government resolution No 447 of 21 April 2005, annex point 1 (consolidated edition in force 2024-08-31 to 2025-05-15, read in a browser into tools/history/browser/lt-447-2024-08-31.txt): a time-based charge in euro for a year, a month, a week or a day, by category (N2 over 3.5 to 12 t, N3 over 12 t), the motor vehicle's own axles (no more than three, or four or more; point 2.2) and EURO class. The table keeps the daily rate. Paid as an e-vignette, without VAT.

sources.title: Via Lietuva: User charge (electronic vignettes): a daily vignette expires 24 hours after its validity starts

vehicles: Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (categories N2 and N3)
